sloka: अथ अब्रवीन् महा बाहुः सुमित्र आनन्द वर्धनम् ।भव सम्रक्षणार्थाय सजने विजनेऽपि वा ॥२-५२-९४॥
transliteration: atha abravīn mahā bāhuḥ sumitra ānanda vardhanam ।bhava samrakṣaṇārthāya sajane vijane'pi vā ॥2-52-94॥

translations.english: The longarmed Rama then said to Lakshmana, enhancer of the joy of Sumitra: Whether in populated areas or in solitary places, excercise alacrity in the matter of protection.
